Instead of moral lecturing the victims, people like her should show the guts to call out the perpetrators of such heinous crimes.

She is indirectly saying, “What’s the big deal if Islamic invaders were raping? Just live with it.”

If she is so worried about pregnant women, then she should read about the atrocities of the Moplah Rebellion, where the bellies of pregnant women were allegedly ripped apart by the Islamist perpetrators of Moplah, with the foetus visible from those ripped bellies.

(Source: Ambedkar’s Pakistan or Partition of India)
